newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jurys Hotels to open inns in London, Limerick.
newsitem.headline: Jurys Hotels to open inns in London, Limerick.

text.p: Irish-based hotel firm Jurys Hotel Group said on Wednesday it was building two new Jurys Inns in London and Limerick.
Jurys said it had bought a site in Pentonville Road, London, for 1.75 million stg, where it would build a 168-bedroom Jurys Inn.
Jurys managing director Peter Malone said there was considerable potential for a Jurys Inn in London.

"Our experience in Ireland has enabled us to develop the concept to an advanced stage so we are going to London with a proven product. When we realise the potential with this project, we will look to establish inns in other British cities over the coming years," he said.
Jurys said it was also establishing a 7.5-million-punt 151-bedroom inn at Mount Kennett in Limerick city on the banks of the River Shannon.
The company said the new Limerick inn would create 80 new jobs in Limerick.

"We are pleased to be bringing the Inns brand to Limerick, particularly given the superb landmark location which is ideally accessible for those travelling to Limerick from the west and south-west," Malone said.
Jurys said an Inn was also currently under construction in Belfast.
The company said the Jurys Inn brand had already been very successfully established in Dublin, Cork and Galway.
